facts:
Focus now: Upgrading the orders service's databases from Postgres 14 to 16
Pieces of work:
- Prod cutover (also called the primary switchover, the prod upgrade): being worked on now. A new Postgres 16 cluster gets prod data by logical replication and has caught up; traffic has not been switched to it. Plan changed; it was an in-place pg_upgrade of the prod primary during a maintenance window. Changed at this step.
- Staging upgrade: delivered. Staging runs on Postgres 16.
- Query plans: being worked on now. Some queries are planned differently on 16. Parts: order lookups: as fast as on 14 again; monthly reports: still slower than on 14.
- Backups: set aside, not being worked on now. Nightly backups of the 16 cluster run, and a restore from one was tested.
- Pooler config: waits on something outside the session. The platform team has to roll out a connection pooler version that supports 16.
- Rollback plan: not started yet. How to move prod back to Postgres 14 if the cutover goes wrong; nothing is written yet.
- On-call runbook: not started yet. What on-call engineers do when the new cluster has trouble; nothing is written yet.
- Read replicas: not started yet. Starts after the prod cutover.
- Monitoring dashboards: not started yet. Dashboards for the Postgres 16 cluster; nothing is built yet.
- Old cluster teardown: not started yet. Shutting down the Postgres 14 cluster after the cutover; nothing is done yet.
- Extension upgrades: delivered. Every extension the service uses has a build for 16.
- Disk sizing: delivered. The new cluster's disks are sized for two years of growth.
Open asks:
- "Keep the Postgres 14 nightly backups for 30 days after the cutover, or delete them after 7?" holds up Backups
Not work:
- rule: No schema changes to the orders database until the cutover is done
- finding: The billing service's database is also on Postgres 14; outside this task
Running work:
- Compares row counts between the old and new prod clusters, for Prod cutover
- Checks slow query plans on Postgres 16, for Query plans
